patents.title: Supporting database constraints in synthetic data generation based on generative adversarial networks
patents.summary: Method for generating synthetic relational data with GANs while enforcing database constraints, decomposed into atomic constraints applied to the generator network. Addresses the same problem as SDV's constraint-augmented generation, pursued independently in a commercial DBMS setting.
patents.evidence: grew out of the SIGMOD 2020 paper W3031844875, which cites SDV as prior art that does not enforce database constraints
